# openlineage-collector

> Emit and receive OpenLineage run events, validate them against the 2-0-2 spec and query upstream and downstream lineage of datasets and jobs Python package `trysac-openlineage-collector`, import name `openlineage_collector`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
